angle: It combines one fully shaded right-tail Z example with million-sample simulations showing the uniform distribution under the null and the shift toward zero when the null is false, plus a rough evidence-strength table.
angle_detail: Start with [00:55]-[02:52] for the worked normal-mean example with the statistic near two and a tail area near two percent, which fixes the conditional-on-the-null reading of the definition. Then study [05:06]-[09:03] for the simulation histograms, including the sample-size increase that shifts false-null p values further toward zero and is named greater power. Treat the guideline at [09:31] as rough rather than a cutoff, and look elsewhere for t, chi-square, interval duality, or multiple-testing material.
